nodes.label: .`pushPending uploads unsynced non-blank notes and marks them synced`()
.`pull writes a brand-new remote note into Room with synced flag`()
.`merge keeps local when local is newer and overwrites when remote is newer`()
.`observeRemote ignores a stale snapshot that would clobber a fresh local edit`()
.`pulled tags are persisted to the tag tables`()
.`purgeTombstones purges local and remote older than the retention window`()
